newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE FARMERS' LEADER BURIED AT HEROES' SHRINE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE FARMERS' LEADER BURIED AT HEROES' SHRINE.

text.p: HARARE, October 26 (Reuter) Veteran Zimbabwean farmers union leader Gary Magadzire, who died from diabetes and blood pressure last Tuesday and was declared a national hero, was buried at the national heroes acre in Harare on Saturaday.
Magadzire, 59, was accorded national hero status by the ruling ZANA-PF politburo -- a rare honour for a non-politician-- for championing the cause of black farmers in post independent Zimbabwe.

He was president of the Zimbabwe Farmers Union and held positions in several international organisations, including vice-president of the International Federation of Agricultural Producers and board member of the International Service for Agriculture Research. --Harare Newsroom: +263-4 72 52 27/8/9.--
